text.heroHeadline: I Turn Raw Footage Into Content People Actually Watch.
text.heroSub: High-retention video editing for creators and businesses that want better content, stronger storytelling, and more attention.
text.aboutBio: I help creators and businesses turn raw footage into content that communicates clearly, feels intentional, and keeps viewers watching. My work spans marketing explainers, healthcare and personal-brand content, and fully animated motion pieces — whatever the platform demands, the goal is the same: hold attention and earn the next second.

projects.title: The Zest Agency
projects.overview: A paid Instagram ad, not an organic post — built with kinetic type and a confident visual rhythm to earn a stop mid-scroll.
projects.goal: Make a sponsored ad that doesn't feel like one, and drive real inbound inquiries.
projects.approach: Fast rhythmic cuts, bold type call-outs, and a restrained palette broken by one red accent for silent-autoplay legibility.
projects.result: 142K views and a wave of DMs asking about pricing and packages — the ad worked.
projects.desc: Paid Instagram ad that drove real DMs.

projects.title: Dr. Ahmed — Dermatology & Cosmetics
projects.overview: A direct-to-camera piece helping a dermatology and laser specialist earn trust before a patient ever books.
projects.goal: Turn expertise into approachable, caption-led content that makes the doctor the obvious choice.
projects.approach: Clean punch-ins on a single-take talking head, timed caption call-outs, and a soft grade matched to the real clinic.
projects.result: An estimated ~89K views for a specialty that lives on trust — reach that converts to bookings.
projects.desc: Talking-head content built to earn patient trust.

projects.title: What The World Chases
projects.overview: A fully animated kinetic-typography piece pairing 3D elements with hand-built motion type.
projects.goal: Show range beyond talking-head editing — 3D, motion, and sound design as one standalone piece.
projects.approach: Custom 3D renders choreographed to a rising voiceover, warm marble backdrops, and frame-by-frame type animation.
projects.result: An estimated ~216K views — production value that travels well past one platform.
projects.desc: 3D elements and kinetic type, frame by frame.

projects.title: Script Framework
projects.overview: A self-promo reel offering a free script framework — the hook, the offer, and the payoff in under 20 seconds.
projects.goal: Turn a scroll-stopping hook into saves, follows, and DM requests for the framework.
projects.approach: Clapperboard motifs, paper-prop stop motion, and tight kinetic type keep the pace brisk and premium.
projects.result: An estimated ~64K views — solid reach for a pure lead-magnet format.
projects.desc: A self-promo hook built to earn saves and follows.

projects.title: The Nvidia Story
projects.overview: A gallery-style explainer on Nvidia's rise from a gaming-chip company to a $140B giant.
projects.goal: Make a dense business story easy to follow and satisfying to finish.
projects.approach: An animated gallery-wall motif, bold caption typography, and pacing that matches each new fact beat.
projects.result: An estimated ~184K views — business storytelling that holds attention to the end.
projects.desc: A gallery-style explainer on a $140B rise.

projects.title: Why Brands Stick
projects.overview: A quick kinetic-type piece on why certain brands stay memorable — motion design as the answer.
projects.goal: Make the case for motion design itself, fast enough to hold on a first watch.
projects.approach: Bold brand callouts, a clean type-driven mid-section, and a playful closing visual metaphor.
projects.result: An estimated ~127K views — proof a 14-second idea can still land.
projects.desc: Kinetic type on what makes branding memorable.
